item.description:
Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Better widgets.

- Click a message in the Mail widget to open that conversation.
- Right-click the widget › Edit "Mail" to pick an account and Inbox or Starred.
- The big number now shows mail that arrived today instead of every unread message.
- Each widget has a compose button, and there's a new large size.

  • Sign-In Code widget. It shows the newest sign-in code from the last 10 minutes. Click to copy.
  • Sender pictures. People in your Google contacts now show their photo instead of an initial. To also use photos from the Contacts app on your Mac, turn it on in Settings › General. If Google pictures don't appear, use Allow Google Contacts… there.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Desktop widget. Add Unread Mail from Edit Widgets to see your unread count at a glance. The larger size also shows your newest unread messages.
  • Focus filters. In System Settings › Focus, pick a Focus such as Work and add a Normal Mail filter with the accounts you want. During that Focus, only those accounts appear in All Inboxes and the sidebar, and only they send notifications.
  • Find mail with Spotlight (optional). Turn on Show mail in Spotlight search in Settings › General › Privacy, then find conversations with ⌘Space by subject or sender. It's off by default, and turning it off removes your mail from Spotlight.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Package tracking. Shipping emails with a UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL or Amazon tracking number now show it at the top, with Track and Copy buttons. The number is found on your Mac. The carrier is only contacted if you click Track.
